title: RecipeElementPipeline
description: Optional element-local pipeline reference into the canonical graph.

graph.description: Graph that owns the nodes used by this element-local pipeline.

topology.description: Optional pipeline topology subset for this element.

GraphStep.description: Canonical execution topology for a graph.

oneOf.description: Execute child steps in order, where each child reads the prior output.
Execute child branches against the same input snapshot, then merge deltas.

children.description: Authored child branches. Child order is deterministic merge order.

mergePolicy.description: Policy used when multiple branches write the same cell channel.

valueMergePolicy.description: Policy used when multiple branches publish the same graph value id.

GraphValueMergePolicy.description: Policy for resolving graph value outputs produced by parallel branches.

oneOf.description: Merge branch value outputs in authored child order; later outputs win.
Reject the merge when multiple branches publish the same graph value id.

NodeId.description: Stable node identifier inside a canonical graph.

ParallelMergePolicy.description: Policy for resolving channel writes produced by parallel graph branches.

oneOf.description: Merge branches in authored child order; later same-channel writes win.
Reject the merge when multiple branches write the same cell channel.

RecipeElementPipelineTiming.description:
Element-local timing for scene layer pipeline effects.

These values are relative to the parent recipe timeline. They do not choose
a clock policy; the recipe lifecycle clock still owns sample-space
interpretation. Renderers use this envelope only to derive a local
`phase_t` for element-local pipeline steps.

enterEase.description: Element-local enter easing label preserved for backend/tooling parity.

enterOffsetMs.description: Offset from parent timeline start before the element enter effect begins.

exitEase.description: Element-local exit easing label preserved for backend/tooling parity.

exitOffsetMs.description: Offset from parent exit timeline start before the element exit effect begins.
